step1_analysis.description: A 4-input pseudo-NMOS logic gate used to select or combine different clock phases (P2-P5) based on control signals (CTRL1-CTRL4). The PMOS acts as an active pull-up load, while the series NMOS pairs act as selectable pull-down paths.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS 400-Mb/s Serial Link for AS-Memory Systems Using a PWM Scheme

VOL.description: Output low voltage when one pull-down branch is active

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the voltage divider between the PMOS pull-up and 2 series NMOS pull-downs. With W=5u, L=0.5u for all, the NMOS network is stronger due to higher electron mobility.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Pseudo-NMOS logic inherently has a non-zero VOL which must be kept low enough to be recognized as a logic '0'.

VOH.description: Output high voltage when all pull-down branches are inactive

sky130_expected.calculation: The PMOS pulls the output to VDD when no static current flows through the pull-down network.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Full rail swing is expected for VOH since the pull-down network is completely off.

t_delay.description: Propagation delay from input phase rising to output falling

sky130_expected.calculation: RC delay of the pull-down network discharging the load capacitance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Comparable to the 500ps timing mentioned in the paper, adjusted for the faster 130nm process.

sky130_expected.calculation: Static power dominates when the output is low. I = ~0.5mA -> P = 1.8V * 0.5mA = 0.9mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 66.5mW reported is for the entire transceiver. This specific sub-block consumes only a small fraction of the total power.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure VOL, VOH, propagation delay, rise/fall times, and average power consumption of the pseudo-NMOS multiplexer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pseudo-NMOS Multiplexer Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

* DUT
XM2 OUT CTRL1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N1 P2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 OUT CTRL2 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 N2 P3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM7 OUT CTRL3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM5 N3 P4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM8 OUT CTRL4 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM6 N4 P5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM9 OUT GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Enable branch 1, disable others
VCTRL1 CTRL1 0 1.8
VCTRL2 CTRL2 0 0
VCTRL3 CTRL3 0 0
VCTRL4 CTRL4 0 0

* 200 MHz input pulse on P2
VP2 P2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 100p 100p 2.4n 5n)
VP3 P3 0 0
VP4 P4 0 0
VP5 P5 0 0

* Load capacitance
CL OUT 0 10f

* Analysis
.control
tran 10p 15n

* Measurements
meas tran v_oh max v(out)
meas tran v_ol min v(out)
meas tran t_delay trig v(p2) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(out) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_rise trig v(out) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(out) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(out) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(out) val=0.36 fall=1

* Power calculation
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_pwr avg pwr

print v_oh v_ol t_delay t_rise t_fall avg_pwr
quit
.endc
